name: wrench_complete
title: Wrench Complete
tagline: The complete West Coast USA street racing career, garage and drivers in one mod
description: Everything in one mod: a hands-on garage with a working lift, a street racing career from a junkyard wreck to the top of the ROC, drivers in every car with injuries in crashes, and rain, dirt and scratches on the car body. All settings are in ESC > Mods. Plays on West Coast USA. Remove the separate Wrench Works, Street Legal, Drivers and Car Surface FX mods before installing this one.
author: Connor Moyle
